sections.summary: The English wording of 6:165 was substantially revised between the 1989 and 1992 editions. 1989 reading begins "He is the One who made you inheritors of the earth, and He raised some of you above others in rank, in order t...". 1992 final reading begins "He is the One who made you inheritors of the earth, and He raised some of you above others in rank, in order t...". Machine comparison candidate; 1981 and 1989 readings are page-transcription extractions that need review.
